sdc.daemon.AnswererLabel.title: AnswererLabel
sdc.daemon.AnswererLabel.description: The name a client gives when it answers a decision (the answered_by of AnswerDecision): ASCII text without control characters, at most 200 characters. The daemon trims it of ASCII whitespace and refuses (400) a longer one, one that holds a non-ASCII or a control character, and one whose lower case starts with `rule:`, `decider:` or `router:`, the names it keeps for the answers of a rule, a decider and a router. It is stored and shown trimmed and is never the principal: the principal of an answer is the daemon's own (runbook serve --principal), fixed when the daemon starts, and a label a client types grants nothing.
